title: Western Blot Analysis Protocol
author: Xiao Bing Tang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kumcwu6
materials: Protein content is evaluated by bicinchoninic acid assay (BCA Protein assay kit by Thermo Fisher) in a spectrophotometer.
Protein samples were separated via sodium dodecyl sulfate/polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis, and transferred to polyvinylidene fluoride membranes (Millipore, Billerica, Mass., USA).
Densitometric values were analyzed by using the ECL Plus detection system (Millipore, Billerica, Mass., USA).

steps.title: Prepare Protein Extracts
steps.instruction: Heat 50μg of protein extracts at 100°C for 5 min.

steps.title: Block PVDF Membrane
steps.instruction: Block the PVDF membrane and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate PVDF membrane in 5% fat-free milk in Tris-buffered saline for 2h at room temperature
Wash the membrane in T-TBS 2 times, 10 min each

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with primary antibody and wash.

substeps.instruction: Incubate PVDF membrane overnight at 4℃ in primary antibody
Wash the membrane in T-TBS 2 times, 10 min each

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with secondary antibody and wash.

substeps.instruction: Incubate PVDF membrane with secondary antibody for 2 hr at room temperature
Wash the membrane in T-TBS 2 times, 10 min each

steps.title: Develop Membranes
steps.instruction: Develop the membranes using a chemiluminescent substrate kit (Pierce, Rockford, Ill., USA).
